# Which rental items pay for themselves? Payback, return and what to buy next

> Free calculator for party and event rental companies. Enter what each item costs, what a rental earns, how often it goes out, handling, breakage and storage; it ranks your inventory by return, shows payback and the lowest price per item. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
